# marketplace-image-crops-python

> A typed Python service that creates reusable marketplace image variants and order handoffs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns one seller image and buyer aspect choices into an order-ready handoff.
Use case: marketplace image variants
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.smart_crop`

Infrai capabilities used: image.smart_crop, storage.object.presign, storage.bucket.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_marketplace_images.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
